notes.title: Special Discount!
notes.content:
[h2]Garden of Seif has been selected to be featured in The Storyteller's Festival.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42653807/4090442878594a632065a6683edf8fdc29801d71.png[/img]

Enjoy Curse of Gravehollow Peaks AND the main Garden of Seif game, Chronicles of an Assassin, at a discount from January 29th - February 4th.

[b]What is all this about anyway?[/b]

The Storyteller's Festival is an event on Steam that showcases 250+ games with fantastic storytelling. There are new releases, announcements, live streams, and SALES! Go check out all the awesome games! 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/thestorytellersfestival2024]Click here to visit the official event page here on Steam. [/url]

Hope you all are enjoying the New Year~

P.S. if you enjoy Garden of Seif, please leave a review to let us know what you liked about it!

notes.title: Launch Day!
notes.content:
[b][h1] ❄️Today is the release of Garden of Seif: Curse of Gravehollow Peaks ❄️ [/h1][/b]

Today we present Curse of Gravehollow Peaks to Steam! This short side story features Iris and Seth from Garden of Seif: Chronicles of an Assassin. 


[b]About Curse of Gravehollow Peaks:[/b]
in the cursed mountains of Gravehollow Peaks, two rival assassins must set their differences aside and find a way home... unless something finds them first. A story-rich fantasy with magic, romance, and choices that matter. 

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42130534/f2706860fb434921267e4a0f2dfc07e3daf60862.jpg[/img]

The Curse of Gravehollow Peaks DLC was originally posted to itchio and made for the 2021 Winter VN Jam, a casual game jam where we worked on a game in under two months. Since then, we've added new endings and choices, and have even polished the game with new artwork over the years. This is the first time the game is launching on Steam!

[b][h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2079430/Garden_of_Seif_Curse_of_Gravehollow_Peaks/?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=devlog&utm_campaign=cursedrelease&utm_content=december2023]Visit the Steam page for Garden of Seif: Chronicles of an Assassin[/url][/h3][/b]
